title: The Ocean at the End of the Lane
author: Neil Gaiman
summary: Returning to his childhood home for a funeral, a man wanders down a lane to a farm where an unusual girl once lived. He starts to remember the strange events of the summer he was seven, and what lived beside the duck pond.
readIf: you want a short, lyrical dark fairy tale about memory and childhood fear.
skipIf: you want a bright story, as it is sad and includes some disturbing moments for a child.

pairings.reason: Same author, a more directly spooky and younger story with a plucky protagonist.
A hushed, odd fantasy with a similar dreamlike feel and very little exposition.
Another story told partly through a child's eyes that treats death and memory gently but frankly.
